page: Microsoft Azure F2as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the Fasv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical AMD EPYC 9V74 cores operating at 3.7 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The processor includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, supporting advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. However, multi-core performance is more constrained, with Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scores falling into the bottom 25%. Memory performance shows a similar divergence: while large-block write bandwidth is average, read-only memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks is weak. The server demonstrates average performance in single-threaded gzip compression and small-model (135M) LLM inference tasks, but registers weak results in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the F2as_v6 offers dedicated AMD EPYC CPU resources with strong single-threaded capabilities, making it a viable option for workloads that do not require high memory density or massive parallel processing. Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, this server is suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, single-threaded application servers, basic text processing, and small-scale development or testing environments. It is less suitable for memory-intensive databases, high-throughput web serving, or heavily multi-threaded compilation tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure F2as_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Fasv6 family, powered by 2 dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 physical cores running at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core) and lacks local storage, though it supports Premium Storage. Benchmark results show strong single-core CPU and text processing performance, placing in the top 25%. However, multi-core performance, memory read bandwidth, and database operations are weaker, falling into the bottom 25%. The server delivers average results for single-threaded compression and small-model LLM inference. This hardware profile makes the F2as_v6 a cost-efficient option for single-threaded applications, lightweight text processing, and basic development environments, while it is less suited for memory-intensive databases or highly parallelized workloads.
